rareDistribution.method: Conditional rare drops at a fixed item tier/cap; actual weighted bases, 9 slots, affix rolls and exceptional bases. Not complete zone loot probabilities or drops/hour.

method.buyerModel: Independent visitors; no shared budget or empty-shop prewarming
method.items: One fixed-seed actual generated weapon per tier/rarity; a sample, not the entire loot distribution.
method.prices: Cheap = floor(fair/2), minimum 1. All four listings have the same item and asking price.
method.quantiles: Across all listings, including unsold as censored. Null means the quantile exceeds the 12-hour horizon.
method.timing: Irregular 10-180s arrivals averaging about 60s. Eligibility at one minute; valuable popular deeply discounted gear can draw 2-4 simultaneous visitors. Sale quantiles use actual arrival timestamps.
method.offers: 15% of proposals bid roughly 20-45% of min(ask,fair); others use ordinary negotiation amounts. Pending bids never block buy-now purchases.
method.controls: No relisting, restocking, replay acceleration, loot bonus, LLM call or existing player save.

goldTrades.limitation: One ideal crafted item, no restock or automatic offer acceptance; this does not describe ordinary drop frequency.
